ARM_ORIG_INVERSE_CURSED_MILLSTONE_DESCRI: Trinket. -30 DEF, with no other stat change.
ARM_ORIG_STARTER_CHAOSMAGE_ENTROPY_ROD_D: Staff, +5 ATK. Carries two abilities on INT, both listed on the ability bar under their common names. Buffing Bleat is the Chaos Mage's Wild Blessing: it grants a chosen ally one of six random buffs. Dark Bolt is her Entropy Bolt: it deals magic damage and, on a PERFECT roll, afflicts the target for 2 turns with one of eight random statuses (never Stun).
ARM_ORIG_STARTER_GARY_RIVAL_ROD_DESCRIPT: Staff, +5 ATK. Carries a basic attack plus three utility abilities: Resistance Down on an enemy, Evasion Up on Gary, and Attack Up on Gary.
ARM_ORIG_STARTER_PACIFIST_OLIVE_BRANCH_D: Staff, +2 ATK. Every ability on it is non-damaging: Attack Down on an enemy, and Armor Up or Attack Up on an ally. This weapon cannot deal damage.
ARM_ORIG_STARTER_TRAINER_BEAST_WHISTLE_D: Staff, +5 ATK. Carries a basic attack (Ray) plus both team commands, listed on the ability bar under their common names: Break Their Guard is Command: Focus Fire, and Scatter is Command: Spread Out.
ARM_ORIG_STARTER_VAMPIRIC_BLOODLETTER_DE: Blade, +6 ATK, with one physical attack (STR) and one magical attack (INT). Pairs with Blood Price and Crimson Drain: every hostile ability costs 3 HP, and dealing damage returns 25% of it as health (minimum 1).
ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_CAPTURE_DESCRIPTIO: Thrown attack that lowers the target's Resistance; a PERFECT roll catches it. Holds exactly one monster at a time, which keeps the HP it had at the end of its last fight and stays downed until revived in a town. Catching a new monster replaces the current one at full HP. The charm has unlimited uses.
ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_FIRE_DESCRIPTION: An empty charm. The Fire line is not implemented yet -- the charm is a slot, and it is waiting for its partner.
ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_GRASS_DESCRIPTION: Sends out your Grass partner. Focus cost scales with stage: stage 1 is free, stage 2 costs 1, stage 3 costs 2, stage 4 costs 3. This line tanks and protects -- while a living partner from it stands in front of you, you take 35% less physical damage.
ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_WATER_DESCRIPTION: An empty charm. The Water line is not implemented yet -- the charm is a slot, and it is waiting for its partner.
CF_ORIG_CHAOSMAGE_DESCRIPTION: Casts spells she cannot aim and blessings she cannot choose. The highest ceiling in the party, the thinnest body, and no way to promise anyone anything.
CF_ORIG_GARY_DESCRIPTION: The rival. Carries one ball and one monster. A PERFECT throw catches whatever he aimed at, and the next thing he catches replaces it -- so the question is never how many, it is which one.
CF_ORIG_PACIFIST_DESCRIPTION: Refuses to strike. Turns aggression back on the attacker and keeps the party standing.
CF_ORIG_TRAINER_DESCRIPTION: Never fights alone. Fields the wolf partner his charm carries, directs it with two team commands, and hides behind it when it stands in front of him.
CF_ORIG_VAMPIRIC_DESCRIPTION: Pays health to swing and drinks it back on contact. Punished for missing, unstoppable when it connects.
STATUS_CHARGE_CF_FOCUS_FIRE_DESCRIPTION: Your trainer called the target. Attacks against the enemy he marked hit for 6 extra damage.
STATUS_EVASIVE_CF_SPREAD_OUT_DESCRIPTION: Working the whole board. +5 attack, and 5 extra damage on each enemy struck -- once per target per round.
STATUS_VIGOR_CF_ENGORGED_DESCRIPTION: Swollen with stolen blood. +8 maximum health while it lasts.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_INVERSE_BLOODRA: Worn hot against the skin, it sharpens every strike and dulls every instinct to duck.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_INVERSE_CURSED_: A stone ring worn round the neck, carved with a curse nobody ever finished reading. It weighs on the wearer's guard and gives nothing back.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_INVERSE_GAMBLER: A locket that rattles with dice instead of a portrait. Every risk it invites pays out in luck, at the cost of a guard left wide open.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_CHAOSMA: A rod of no fixed element, carrying exactly two spells and neither of them will tell you what it is going to do until it has done it. The ability bar shows them under their common names -- BUFFING BLEAT is the Chaos Mage's WILD BLESSING, and DARK BOLT is her ENTROPY BOLT. Wild Blessing hands a chosen ally one of six boons at random: armour, resistance, evasion, a ward that fully negates the next hit, a reflect, or regeneration. You pick who; you never pick what. Entropy Bolt always deals magical damage and, on a PERFECT roll, the Entropy passive also afflicts the target with one of eight elements chosen at random -- never Stun. Both roll on Intellect, so one stat carries the whole weapon.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_GARY_RI: Gary's walking stick, carried like a trophy. Strikes, lowers Resistance, and talks him into a better position.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_PACIFIS: A branch, offered rather than swung. Every one of its techniques stuns, weakens or shields - none of them deal a single point of damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_TRAINER: A carved whistle pitched for animal ears. Two calls, and your partners answer both of them. The ability bar lists each call under its ordinary name; the command is what the whistle adds on top.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_VAMPIRI: A thin, fluted blade that drinks as deeply as it cuts.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_CA: A hollow charm that holds exactly one monster. Throw it at an enemy: the throw lowers Resistance, and on a PERFECT roll it catches. The charm is never used up - throw it as often as you like - but it only ever holds one monster, and a second charm adds no second monster. Anyone can carry it, and anyone carrying it can catch.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_FI: A charm with nothing in it yet. The Fire partner line is not implemented; the charm is carried as a slot for one.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_GR: A charm that carries your Grass partner's scent. Sending out a later stage costs more focus: stage 1 is free, stage 2 costs 1, stage 3 costs 2, stage 4 costs 3. Protection. It shields the party -- armour and resistance buffs, a ward that fully negates the next attack on an ally, roots that keep melee off your back row, and a taunt that pulls the swing onto itself. Stand behind it and you take 35% less physical damage. It hits like a wet leaf.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_WA: A charm with nothing in it yet. The Water partner line is not implemented; the charm is carried as a slot for one.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_BOOMERANG_ATTACKDOWN_ATT: Inflicts -5 Attack on one enemy for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_BOSS_HOBGOBLIN_CHAMPION_: Stage 4 of the Rime line. The guardian: it barely scratches anything, but it stuns, chills targets into taking 25% more damage, and armours your side. (90 health, 21 attack, 11 armour, 12 resistance, 5 abilities.)
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_BOSS_SKRAEVIN_BIG_05: Stage 3 of the Chaos line. The bruiser: it holds the front, soaks hits, and grinds one target down with bleed and weakened attacks. (80 health, 17 attack, 8 armour, 6 resistance, 4 abilities.)
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_BOSS_SKRAEVIN_SMALL_03: Stage 2 of the Chaos line. The bruiser: it holds the front, soaks hits, and grinds one target down with bleed and weakened attacks. (52 health, 13 attack, 6 armour, 4 resistance, 3 abilities.)
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_BOSS_SUNDERBONE_05: Stage 3 of the Ember line. The striker: fragile and fast to kill with, and the only partner that sets several enemies alight at once. (49 health, 21 attack, 3 armour, 4 resistance, 4 abilities.)
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_CF_TRAINER_SUMMON_GRASS_: Sends out stage 1 of the Grass line. Focus cost 0.
Sends out stage 2 of the Grass line. Focus cost 1.
Sends out stage 3 of the Grass line. Focus cost 2.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_COMPANION_WOLF_HELLHOUND: Stage 1 of the Chaos line. The bruiser: it holds the front, soaks hits, and grinds one target down with bleed and weakened attacks. (29 health, 9 attack, 4 armour, 2 resistance, 2 abilities.)
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ARMORUP_FULL_ATTACK: Grants yourself +99 Armor for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ARMORUP_OTHER_ATTAC: Grants an ally +5 Armor for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ARMORUP_SPLASH_ATTA: Grants the target ally and adjacent allies +4 Armor for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ATTACKDOWN_ATTACK: Inflicts -5 Attack on an enemy for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ATTACKUP_02_ATTACK: Grants yourself +15 Attack for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ATTACKUP_03_ALL_ATT: Grants every ally in your group +20 Attack for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ATTACKUP_ALL_ATTACK: Grants the whole party +4 Attack for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ATTACKUP_ATTACK: Grants yourself +5 Attack for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_ATTACKUP_OTHER_ATTA: Grants an ally +5 Attack for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_EVADEUP_ATTACK: Grants yourself +35 Evasion for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_EVADEUP_SPLASH_ATTA: Grants yourself and adjacent allies +25 Evasion for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_RESISTDOWN_AOE_ATTA: Inflicts -10 Resistance on every enemy for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_RESISTDOWN_ATTACK: Inflicts -10 Resistance on an enemy for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_RESISTUP_03_ALL_ATT: Grants the whole party +20 Resistance for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_RESISTUP_OTHER_ATTA: Grants an ally +5 Resistance for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ONLY_RESISTUP_SPLASH_ATT: Grants the target ally and adjacent allies +5 Resistance for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_PLANT_AOE_POISON_ATTACK: A melee strike that deals physical damage across a 3x3 area of enemy tiles and poisons everyone it hits for 3 turns.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_CHAOSMAGE_BACKL: Botch a hostile spell badly enough and it goes off on you instead: one random affliction from the same eight Entropy uses, for 2 turns. Once per round. What you inflict is what you risk.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_CHAOSMAGE_ENTRO: On a PERFECT Entropy Bolt (shown on the bar as DARK BOLT), afflict the target for 2 turns with one of Poison, Fire, Shock, Wet, Bleed, Acid, Ice or Confuse. Never Stun. Only PERFECT rolls apply it, so Intellect is what makes this class work. Wet is the draw to hope for: a soaked enemy has no immunities left to hide behind. Fire and Ice both cancel against Wet, so a later bolt can wash an earlier one off.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_CHAOSMAGE_RESON: Against a target already suffering two or more afflictions, you declare abilities with +15% Intellect. Chaos compounds: the more that is already wrong with an enemy, the more reliably you make it worse.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_CHAOSMAGE_WILD_: At the start of your turn, 15% chance to leave Fire, Water, Shock or Acid lying on a random tile for 5 turns. Any tile on the board. Including one of yours, with your own party standing on it. Once per round, and it costs you nothing, which is precisely why it is dangerous.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_GARY_RIVALS_EDG: +6 Luck on every ability Gary declares. His catches happen on PERFECT rolls, so Luck is the whole class.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_GARY_SMELL_YA_L: Defeating an enemy grants Gary Evasion Up for 2 turns.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PACIFIST_CROUCH: At the end of your turn, gain Reflect for 2 turns. Reflect returns half of one incoming attack (minimum 1) to the attacker, then is used up. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PACIFIST_FIELD_: At the end of your turn, restore 4 health to the ally with the lowest percentage of health remaining. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PACIFIST_WHY_CA: Whenever you take damage, the attacker takes 30% of that damage back, up to a maximum of 12. Always triggers. Your weapon deals no damage at all, so this is how a Pacifist fights.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PARTNER_CMD_FOC: While marked by Focus Fire, this partner deals 6 extra damage to an enemy, once per target per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PARTNER_CMD_SPR: While marked by Spread Out, this partner deals 5 extra damage to an enemy it has not already struck this round. Hitting the same enemy twice pays nothing.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_BOND_ST: Each point of Bond adds +3% Awareness to every ability you declare, capping at +30% once your Bond reaches 10. Bond is built by Gotta Train 'Em.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CAPTURE: At the start of every battle, the monster in your Capture Ball is sent out to fight beside you. It keeps the health it ended the last battle with; at 0 health it is downed and stays in the ball until a town revives it.

A PERFECT throw of the Capture Ball catches the target: it leaves the fight and becomes your monster. Bosses, scourges, and creatures with no doll family cannot be caught, and neither can anything whose own moveset can stun - a throw at one of those says so on screen and costs you nothing. One catch per battle. Catching again replaces the monster you had.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CMD_FOC: Marks one enemy with the Focus Fire marker on the whole party for 2 turns: while it is up, a partner that hits the marked enemy deals 6 extra damage, once per target per round. Your partners are also ordered onto that enemy.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CMD_SPR: For 2 turns the party carries the Spread Out marker: +5 attack, and a partner deals 5 extra damage to each enemy it strikes -- once per target per round, so working across the board pays and re-hitting the same enemy does not.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_GOTTA_T: Every enemy you defeat raises your Bond by 1, to a maximum of 10. Bond feeds Bond Strength, and carries through the whole combat.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_GRASS_1: At bond 0-2, Barkling joins you at the start of every fight.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_GRASS_2: At bond 3-8, Hellhowl joins you at the start of every fight.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_GRASS_3: At bond 9 or higher, Chaosmutt joins you at the start of every fight.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_SHIELDE: While a living partner stands on the tile directly in front of him, the Trainer takes 35% less physical damage (at least 2 less). Move that partner away, or let it die, and the cover is gone.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_TYPE_AD: Your POKEMON's PERFECT attack rolls have a 35% chance to afflict the target with Shock, Bleed, Poison or Resistance Down for 2 turns. The Trainer's own attacks do not carry it.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_BAT_SW: Once you have gorged 3 times, the next enemy you slay rises again as a vampire bat that fights for you, and the count resets to 0. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_BLOOD_: Every hostile ability costs you 3 health. Always triggers, cannot be blocked or reduced by armour, and it is paid whether the attack hits or misses.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_CRIMSO: Whenever you deal damage, you recover 25% of it as health, always at least 1. Always triggers. This is what pays back Blood Price, so connecting matters more than swinging often.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_ENGORG: Draining while already at full health makes you Engorged: +8 maximum health for 3 turns, letting the drain carry you above your normal maximum. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKRAEVIN_ARMOR_RES_BUFF: Grants one ally +10 Armor and +10 Resistance for 2 turns. Deals no damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_WOLF_CHAOSHOUND_10: Grass partner, stage 3 of 3. 48 HP - the bottom decile of the shipped creature curve; it acts every round and that is what it is paid for. Applies tier-3 statuses (config suffix _10).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_WOLF_GRASS_08: Grass partner, stage 1 of 3. 16 HP - the bottom decile of the shipped creature curve; it acts every round and that is what it is paid for. Applies tier-3 statuses (config suffix _08).
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_WOLF_HELLHOUND_09: Grass partner, stage 2 of 3. 32 HP - the bottom decile of the shipped creature curve; it acts every round and that is what it is paid for. Applies tier-3 statuses (config suffix _09).
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_CHAOSMAGE_DESCRIPTION: Casts spells she cannot aim and blessings she cannot choose. The highest ceiling in the party, the thinnest body, and no way to promise anyone anything.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_GARY_DESCRIPTION: Catches a monster on a PERFECT ball throw and fights alongside it from the next battle on. Exactly one at a time; it keeps its wounds between fights and only a town heals it. Bosses and scourges cannot be caught.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_PACIFIST_DESCRIPTION: Refuses to strike. Turns aggression back on the attacker and keeps the party standing.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_TRAINER_DESCRIPTION: Never fights alone. Fields a wolf partner that acts every round and grows through three stages as your Bond does, and hides behind it whenever it is standing directly in front of him.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_VAMPIRIC_DESCRIPTION: Pays health to swing and drinks it back on contact. Punished for missing, unstoppable when it connects.
UI_TOOLTIP_WOLF_CHAOSHOUND_10_DESCRIPTIO: Chaosmutt, the last of the Grass line. A chaoshound on a charm instead of a leash. It wards and armours the whole line at once, dares the enemy to come through it, strips a target's armour and resistance, and finishes with a bite that does not obey the usual rules. Immune to fire, ice and shock.
UI_TOOLTIP_WOLF_GRASS_08_DESCRIPTION: Barkling, the first of the Grass line. A half-grown wolf that plants itself in front of whoever feeds it: it hardens an ally's armour, snarls until the enemy swings at it instead, and bites one target when nobody needs guarding.
UI_TOOLTIP_WOLF_HELLHOUND_09_DESCRIPTION: Hellhowl, the second of the Grass line. The same wolf, come back from somewhere hotter. It wards an ally against the next blow outright, stiffens the whole line's guard, takes the hits meant for the back row, and breathes fire across a cluster of enemies. Immune to fire.
